name: Web Interface Guidelines
summary: Agent skill that audits UI code against Vercel's Web Interface Guidelines and reports terse file:line findings.
description: A SKILL.md package that reviews files for compliance with the Web Interface Guidelines. Before each review it fetches the latest guidelines from a source URL, reads the given files or patterns, checks them against every rule and outputs findings in a terse file:line format, covering design, accessibility and UX best practices.
contains: audits UI code against the Web Interface Guidelines
fetches fresh guidelines before each review
accepts file paths or glob patterns as arguments
covers design, accessibility and UX rules
